newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed on Wednesday in moderate trade on interbank and retail interest, dealers said.
"The interbank rate remained unchanged today. Treasury bill yields were narrowly mixed but bond prices were steady. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.

In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 1.24/19 percent compared with Tuesday's yield of 1.17/12 percent. One-year was unchanged from Tuesday's yield of 1.35/30 percent. Among bonds, July 1998 rose to S$102.33/43 from Tuesday's close of S$99.53/58. March 2001 eased to S$99.75/85 from Tuesday's
June 2003 remained unchanged from Tuesday's close of S$99.52/57.
The overnight interbank offered rate remained at Tuesday's close of 3-5/8 3-1/2 percent.
